propositions: Directory creation and first event write to ticket paths race under interrupted writes, leaving empty stray ticket dirs flagged by fsck as MISSING_CREATE and FOREIGN_STORE_PATH
os.makedirs is called outside the write lock before the first event file is placed, creating a window where host sleep, kill, or timeout leaves an orphaned empty directory
Staging atomicity is achieved by building directory and CREATE event together in a dot-prefixed temporary path and publishing with a single os.rename under the write lock
Temporary staging paths are invisible to fsck via existing dot-prefix exclusion rules in _ticket_dirs and foreign_store_path_list without scanner changes

All same-signature dir-then-file sites in the store write path (batch_stage_and_commit, inbound_translate._write_event_file, dispatch_one BRIDGE_ALERT) are converted to use atomic staging or explicitly exempted

Stale staging directories owned by dead processes are cleaned on writer start via bounded best-effort sweep using lock owner v2 stamp, without violating bug 043f (no writer-side cleanup of event-less ticket dirs)
